title: Perplexity will watch the page, then ping the agent.
friendlyTitle: Perplexity can watch a page, then message your agent.
summary: Perplexity has launched a Monitor API that checks a topic across the web, or up to 10 specific pages, on a schedule and sends a webhook when an update passes its goal checks. Web monitors cost $1 per 1,000 successful runs. Page monitors cost $1 per 1,000 URLs fetched. It uses the same API key as Perplexity Search.
friendlySummary: Perplexity has launched a Monitor tool for developers. It can watch a topic on the web, or up to 10 specific pages, on a schedule. It sends a message to your app only when an update matches the goal you set. Watching the web costs $1 per 1,000 successful checks. Watching pages costs $1 per 1,000 pages fetched.
whyItMatters: A webhook is a nudge, not a decision. Perplexity says a page monitor saves a baseline and later returns a text diff, and each update includes a confidence score. You still decide whether the pricing change, the changelog, or the filing is worth acting on.
friendlyWhyItMatters: A message is a nudge, not a decision. For a known page, Perplexity says it saves a first copy and later shows what changed, with a confidence score. You still decide whether a price change, a changelog, or a filing is worth acting on.
